# Test parsing a real CoreGraphics function from Apple's documentation
# This test uses CGContextMoveToPoint as an example

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

# Parse the function using occ2go command
exec occ2go $INPUT_DIR/CoreGraphics/CGContextMoveToPoint.json
stdout 'func CGContextMoveToPoint'
stdout 'c CGContextRef'
stdout 'x CGFloat'
stdout 'y CGFloat'
stdout 'Begins a new subpath'
